newsitem.title: JAPAN: Arrk Corp higher on firm earnings forcast.
newsitem.headline: Arrk Corp higher on firm earnings forcast.

text.p: Shares in Arrk Corp, which listed on Wednesday, were higher on the over-the-counter market on Thursday afternoon due to a firm earnings forcast, brokers said.
At 0450 GMT, the shares were at 2,770 yen, up from 2,600 yen on Wednesday. Volume was 1.3 million shares.
Brokers said the Japan Company Handbook, published by Toyo Keizai Inc, forecast a rise in the earnings of manufacturers of sample models of industrial products -- such as cars and television sets.
Parent current profit for the 1997/1998 business year is expected to rise to one billion yen, according to the handbook, compared with the firm's own forecast of 658 million yen
"According to the handbook, the equity per share is expected to be 70.20 yen, and investors are buying on the prediction," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
